sources: Esri World_Imagery around the site points

hookups.source: cpwshop.com campsiteDetails for sites 401-407 (every one 'Site Type: Basic', no electricity/water/sewer hookup) + https://cpw.state.co.us/camping ('Basic Amenities Campsite: Tent pad, Table, Grill and/or fire ring'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 7 basic drive-in back-in sites (401-407), maximum vehicle lengths 60-70 ft.

sites.source: cpwshop.com campsiteDetails for sites 401-407 (Loop: Cross Creek; Maximum Vehicle Length 60-70; Driveway Entry Back-In) + campgroundDetails loop listing (Cross Creek: 7 Basic sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Cross Creek is not on the park's November 1 closing list, so it stays open through the winter, with limited services (no water October-April; vault toilets year-round).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park/eleven-mile-state-park-camping-lodging ('Eleven Mile is open for winter camping, but not all campsites are available during the winter months, and services are limited'; the 'Campgrounds closing for the season November 1' list names Rocky Ridge C-E, North Shore B-E, Stoll Mountain, Lazy Boy, Rocking Chair 610-613, Howbert Point and Witcher's Cove 807-822, not Cross Creek), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com (Eleven Mile State Park listing, loop Cross Creek) or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. Cross Creek takes bookings through the winter. 14 days in any 28-day period; six people and up to two motorized vehicles per site; check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park/eleven-mile-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Eleven Mile State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-28

note: Small drive-in loop on the west arm of Eleven Mile Reservoir, ~8,580 ft; open grassland just above the shore. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: sites 15 -> 7 (401-407, all basic back-ins, 60-70 ft); confirmed no electric (and no water/sewer), reservation-only on cpwshop; added year-round season (not on the Nov 1 closing list), url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees ($28 basic, re-confirmed on cpwshop for 2027) and facilities (vault toilets, hand pumps stated park-wide) left as stored. Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/booking restatements, 'big-rig friendly' and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags all 7 Cross Creek sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'. On Esri imagery the loop sits on open grass at the shore of a cove, the site points ~40-80 m from the waterline in that image, nothing between; imagery date/pool level unknown. No contrary claim.
Pin 38.9483,-105.5654 is at the loop entrance, 45 m from the 7-site centroid (38.94859,-105.56504).
Site count: the stored ~15 is not supported - cpwshop lists 7 sites in the Cross Creek loop (a second turnaround loop to the SE on imagery carries no campsites in the catalog).
